content_zh:
林柔下了车，不好意思地松开陈阳的手，两人并肩走向食堂。
“我擦，这小子到底是哪里好，校花竟然上了他的车。”
“上车就算了，关键还是辆自行车。”
“自行车就算了，而且还是辆破烂自行车。”
一个个牲口眼中满是郁闷和忧伤，心里想不明白自己哪里比不上陈阳，为什么没有得到清纯校花的青睐。
陈阳和林柔到了东安工大的食堂，本来是陈阳请客，可他没有饭卡，最后反而是林柔请了他。
两人找了个位置坐下，陈阳道：“柔柔，今天你请了我，下次我可得还你一顿大餐才行。”
“没关系，只是几块钱而已。”
林柔微微一笑，顿时惹得周围男学生的眼睛都直了，恨不得自己变成陈阳，可以和林柔面对面进餐。
就在这时，林柔的手机响了，是条短信，室友让她看校内BBS的帖子。
她用手机坏透了。
陈阳瞅了瞅林柔的手机，笑道：“什么东西，给我看看。”
林柔撅了撅嘴，一副气呼呼的样子，把手机递给陈阳，嘟哝道：“这些人就会胡言乱语，根本就是标题党，真是太可恶了。”
陈阳看了手机上的内容，一本正经道：“果然是标题党，老司机开个车而已，非得弄个《清纯校花坐上神秘男子的大杠，忽上忽下》，简直是欺骗我这种单纯的学生。”
看着陈阳认真的样子，林柔一愣，心头暗道：“难道他真的没看出那个标题的含义，认为是在说骑自行车？不过，老司机开车，又是什么意思？”
林柔沉默了下，一脸好奇地看向陈阳：“你说的老司机开车是什么意思？”
这话林柔说得肆无忌惮，周围的人都听见了，顿时眼睛瞪得老大，表情一个比一个精彩。
这还是我们那个清纯校花吗，她竟然在和别人讨论老司机开车？
那岂不成污污污污……
林柔注意到别人的眼神，秀眉微蹙，吐了吐舌头，低声道：“陈阳，我说错了什么吗？老司机开车到底是什么意思？”

“当然没说错什么。”陈阳嘿嘿一笑，正欲给林柔解释，旁边一道声音响起：“林柔，这小子说的老司机开车，其实是那些污言秽语，他是在猥亵你，你却还茫然不知。”
听到这话，林柔俏脸刷的通红，有些纠结地看着陈阳：“他说的是真的？”
其实在林柔内心里，她把救过自己的陈阳当成了好人，她并不愿意相信陈阳会说这种猥琐的话。
陈阳见有人搅局，瘪了瘪嘴，转头一看，赫然发现竟然是个熟人，正是昨晚飙车时鄙视过他的李恒江，没想到竟然也是东安工大的学生。
“哇，是李恒江学长，好帅呀！”
“原来他就是李恒江学长，不仅人长得帅，听说家里还十分富裕，而且是校学生会副主席。”
“如果能嫁给这样的男人，这辈子就没遗憾了。”
李恒江的出现，吸引了食堂里女生们花痴的目光，他潇洒地捋了捋头发，扬起高傲的头颅，鄙视地看着陈阳：“小子，竟然调戏林柔，现在不知道该怎么给她解释了吧？”
陈阳心头冷笑，表面上做出一副生气的样子，指着李恒江道：“你别污蔑我，我的意思是说我骑着自行车，可是你竟然扭曲我的意思，难道你是看不起我穷，认为我骑自行车，就不配叫做开车了吗？我开个玩笑而已，你却说我猥亵柔柔，简直是对她的侮辱，不可饶恕。”
看着陈阳激动的样子，林柔目光一亮，脸上露出坚定之色，心里暗道：“果然如此，陈阳不是坏人。”
李恒江看出林柔相信了陈阳的话，他顿时就急了，道：“陈阳，你休想歪曲事实，在场的人，谁不知道老司机开车，是污的。”
“我就不知道。”林柔气哼哼地开口，面露愠色，站起身看向李恒江道：“李恒江学长，我知道你想追求我，可你也不能因此而诋毁我身边的人。陈阳是个好人，我要你为刚才的污蔑，向他道歉。”
见林柔挺身而出保护陈阳，食堂的男生都是羡慕不已，心说这穷小子命也太好了。
李恒江皱了下眉头，解释道：“林柔，陈阳不是个好人，你怎么能相信他的话。”

content_en:
Lin Rou got out of the car, embarrassedly let go of Chen Yang's hand, and they walked side by side to the canteen.
"Oh no, what's wrong with this kid? The school beauty actually got into his car."
"It doesn't matter if you get on the car, the key is still a bicycle."
"Forget about the bicycle, and it's still a crappy bicycle."
The eyes of each animal were full of depression and sadness, and they couldn't understand why they were inferior to Chen Yang and why they were not favored by the innocent school beauty.
Chen Yang and Lin Rou arrived at the cafeteria of Dong'an University of Technology. Chen Yang was originally the one to treat them, but he didn't have a meal card, so in the end it was Lin Rou who invited him.
The two of them found a seat and sat down. Chen Yang said: "Rourou, you invited me today, and I have to give you a big meal next time."
"It's okay, it's just a few dollars."
Lin Rou smiled slightly, which immediately made the male students around her stare blankly. They wished they could become Chen Yang and have dinner face to face with Lin Rou.
At this moment, Lin Rou's cell phone rang. It was a text message. Her roommate asked her to read the posts on the school BBS.
She is terrible with her cell phone.
Chen Yang looked at Lin Rou's cell phone and said with a smile: "What is it, show me."
Lin Rou pouted and looked angrily. She handed the phone to Chen Yang and muttered: "These people are just talking nonsense. They are just clickbait. It's really abominable."
Chen Yang read the content on his phone and said seriously: "It's really just a clickbait. The old driver is just driving a car. He has to make a "pure school beauty sits on the mysterious man's big bar, up and down". It is simply deceiving a simple student like me."
Seeing Chen Yang's serious look, Lin Rou was stunned and thought to herself: "Did he really not see the meaning of the title and thought it was talking about riding a bicycle? But what does it mean when an experienced driver drives a car?"
Lin Rou was silent for a moment and looked at Chen Yang curiously: "What do you mean by an old driver driving?"
Lin Rou said this so brazenly that everyone around her heard it, their eyes widened and their expressions became more exciting than the last.
Is this still our innocent school beauty? She is actually discussing driving with others?
Wouldn’t that become dirty dirty dirty...
Lin Rou noticed the eyes of others, frowned slightly, stuck out her tongue, and whispered: "Chen Yang, did I say something wrong? What does it mean for an old driver to drive?"
"Of course I said nothing wrong." Chen Yang chuckled and was about to explain to Lin Rou when a voice from beside him said: "Lin Rou, what this guy said about an old driver driving is actually those dirty words. He was molesting you, but you still don't know it."
Hearing this, Lin Rou's pretty face turned red and she looked at Chen Yang with some confusion: "Is what he said true?"
In fact, in Lin Rou's heart, she regarded Chen Yang, who had saved her, as a good person. She was not willing to believe that Chen Yang would say such obscene words.
Chen Yang frowned when he saw someone disrupting the situation. When he turned around, he was surprised to find that it was an acquaintance. It was Li Hengjiang who had despised him while racing last night. Unexpectedly, he was also a student of Dong'an University of Technology.
"Wow, it's Senior Li Hengjiang, so handsome!"
"It turns out that he is senior Li Hengjiang. Not only is he handsome, I heard that his family is very wealthy, and he is the vice president of the school student union."
"If you can marry such a man, you will have no regrets in this life."
Li Hengjiang's appearance attracted the lustful eyes of the girls in the cafeteria. He smoothed his hair coolly, raised his proud head, and looked at Chen Yang with contempt: "Young man, you actually molested Lin Rou. Now you don't know how to explain it to her, do you?"
Chen Yang sneered in his heart and looked angry on the surface. He pointed at Li Hengjiang and said: "Don't slander me. I meant that I ride a bicycle, but you actually twisted my meaning. Do you look down on me because I am poor and think that I am not worthy of being called a driver when I ride a bicycle? I was just joking, but you called me obscene and soft. It is an insult to her, no.Forgivable. "
Seeing Chen Yang's excited look, Lin Rou's eyes lit up, a look of determination appeared on her face, and she thought to herself: "As expected, Chen Yang is not a bad person. "
Li Hengjiang saw that Lin Rou believed Chen Yang's words, and he immediately became anxious and said: "Chen Yang, don't even think about distorting the facts. Everyone present doesn't know that the old driver is dirty when driving. "
"I don't know. Lin Rou spoke angrily, with a sullen look on her face. She stood up and looked at Li Hengjiang and said, "Senior Li Hengjiang, I know you want to pursue me, but you can't slander the people around me because of this." Chen Yang is a good man. I want you to apologize to him for the slander just now. "
Seeing Lin Rou standing up to protect Chen Yang, the boys in the cafeteria were all envious, thinking that this poor boy's life was too good.
Li Hengjiang frowned and explained: "Lin Rou, Chen Yang is not a good person, how can you believe his words. "
